entries.name: AlphaRidge.ai
entries.whatItDoes: AlphaRidge reads the world's financial news — about 290,000 articles a day from ~13,000 sources — and turns it into structured market data powering the AlphaRidge product (charts, screener, events browser, API). Miners produce per-article analysis: asset sentiment, Wikidata/ticker entity resolution, economic data points, contagion chains, narrative tags, embeddings.
entries.hardwareRec: 8GB VRAM minimum, 24GB+ comfortable (RTX 4090 fits); 16-32GB RAM, 8-16+ CPU cores, 60-100GB disk. ~44GB of models download on first run. NER stage is CPU-heavy: core count sets throughput, and throughput is what you're paid for. Rentals acceptable.
keyRequirements: OpenRouter API key — you pay your own LLM inference (2 of 4 pipeline stages)
Registered hotkey on netuid 45
Return batch leases in time; late batches requeue to others
Batch audits: whole batch discarded if the validator's blind sample doesn't reproduce
Reputation multiplier gates pay; penalties can zero a window
entries.minerJob: Run neurons.miner with the analyzer pipeline (spaCy transformer NER, ReFinED entity linking, two LLM stages via OpenRouter). Validators lease batches; you analyze at roughly 12-18s per article. The validator blind-re-runs a sample of each batch and discards the entire batch on mismatch. Pay = verified volume × reputation (EMA through a logistic gate), priced in USD per point rather than alpha. Batch size ramps with demonstrated throughput; multiple UIDs do not multiply pay.
minerJobProvide: Per-article structured analysis (sentiment, entities, tickers)
Contagion chains, narrative tags, embeddings
Batch turnaround within lease windows
Sample-reproducible outputs audit after audit
entries.top10Strategy: Throughput × quality economics: more CPU cores and faster, cheaper LLM calls raise verified volume; a single failed audit wastes the batch and dents reputation. Newcomers: expect tiny first batches that ramp, budget OpenRouter spend carefully, fix NAT/nginx header quirks, and watch the observatory leaderboard to see reputation as validators do.
top10Levers: Batch audit pass rate protecting reputation
entries.followTopMiners: Track the miner leaderboard on alpharidge.ai (live throughput + reputation), taostats.io/subnet/45 for incentive spread, and repo commits for pipeline/model changes.

entries.name: InfiniteQuant
entries.whatItDoes: InfiniteQuant is a signal market: miners commit encrypted directional trade calls (2-hour drand timelock), validators grade them against real market candles, and emissions go to miners with statistically proven edge — Wilson lower-bound hit-rate >=50% on enough decisive trades, scaled by hit-rate tiers. Two mechanisms: low-frequency (3 calls/day) and high-frequency (30 calls/day).
entries.hardwareRec: CPU only: Python 3.10 venv on any small VPS. No GPU, no market-data subscription (validators handle all pricing). Feed token comes via Telegram bot; the miner is non-custodial and extremely lightweight. Rentals irrelevant.
keyRequirements: 3 signals/day per hotkey, 1h minimum gap (LF); TP/SL symmetric 1:1 per-asset bands
Unrevealed blob = decisive LOSS; 3 bad blobs in 30d zeroes the hotkey 30 days
8-day warmup: dust weight, warmup wins never pay
Copy penalty: shadowing an existing (pair, direction) voids copied wins
HF mode: 50 submissions over 8 distinct days + per-pair direction diversity gates
entries.minerJob: Pick a pair and direction, encrypt the signal with the 2-hour drand timelock, and put SHA256(signal) on-chain via set_commitment (entry price derives from the commit block). After reveal, validators verify the plaintext against the hash and grade on 1-minute candles: TP first = WON, SL first = LOST, neither = WASH. Weight ∝ trailing-7-day qualified wins (cap 20, linear decay) × shrunk-hit-rate tier (1.0×/1.2×/2.0×). HF mode sends signed WebSocket frames with countersigned receipts and Merkle-rooted windows.
minerJobProvide: Encrypted directional trade calls (commit + reveal)
Reveals matching the on-chain hash
Wilson-qualified hit-rate (>=50% lower bound)
Direction diversity and first-mover originality
entries.top10Strategy: Real forecasting edge, not infrastructure: with 3 calls/day, selectivity and conviction matter — tiers reward 60% (1.2×) and 70% (2.0×) shrunk hit-rates, and luck cannot qualify. Newcomers: use the 8-day warmup to build a record free, respect the copy penalty by being first, and add the HF board only with genuine two-sided discipline.
entries.followTopMiners: Track taostats.io/subnet/89 weights and top UIDs, the repo's release cadence and config.SUBMISSION_RULES_HISTORY / signals-bands.json updates, and the Telegram bot (@Iqsignals2026_bot) community for rule changes.

entries.name: Score
entries.whatItDoes: TurboVision (Score) is a decentralized intelligence layer for live video and imagery, focused on professional sports. Validators run scoring jobs per Element from a manifest - building ground truth (real or SAM3 pseudo-GT), calling eligible miners' models from the on-chain registry, and paying per-Element winners. Sports and media buyers get structured, decision-ready data from raw footage.
entries.hardwareRec: Per platform data: 1x GPU with >=16GB VRAM; RTX 5090, B200, H200, H20, MI300X explicitly excluded - plan 4090/A6000/L40S-class hardware. Workload is computer-vision model serving on video.
keyRequirements: Contribute models that solve Elements in the active Manifest
Hugging Face account with write access (HUGGINGFACE_USERNAME/API_KEY required)
Chutes developer account and CHUTES_API_KEY required
Validators call eligible miners from the on-chain registry and score outputs on live data
Per-element weight share; winners chosen over each element's eval_window (days)
Bittensor hotkey folder copied onto every host running TurboVision
entries.minerJob: Miners publish and serve vision models addressing the Manifest's Elements (detection/tracking-style tasks on sports footage). The validator runner executes scoring jobs on a fixed block cadence (default 300 blocks per element): it fetches a challenge, builds ground truth, calls eligible registered miners, scores outputs, and emits shards to R2; aggregated per-Element scores pick winners whose weight share is normalized and set on-chain. MINER.md was 404 at research time, so follow repo docs and Score's channels for the exact miner contract.
minerJobProvide: Vision model endpoints solving Manifest Elements
Accurate predictions on live video/imagery windows
Reliable availability at each element's block cadence
HF-hosted model artifacts with pinned versions
Consistent scores across eval windows
entries.top10Strategy: Score is per-Element winner-take-share: pick Elements where competition is thin and accuracy against the validator's ground-truth pipeline (real GT or SAM3 pseudo-GT) is achievable. Optimize for the actual scoring windows - 300-block cadence, eval_window lookbacks - not generic benchmarks. A newcomer wins by shipping one high-accuracy Element fast and then iterating on the pseudo-GT edge cases validators actually measure.
entries.followTopMiners: Track taostats.io/subnet/44 weight holders, Manifest updates in the repo (elements, weights, blacklist file), and winner snapshots emitted on every set_weights; watch wearescore.com and Score's channels for manifest changes.
